title: San Sebastian food tour: pintxo tasting paired with wines
summary: A local guide takes you round traditional Old Town bars for eight pintxos, three wines, a cider and a local liqueur per person.

title: San Sebastian: Pintxos and Wine Tour
summary: Guided walking tour in English with 8 pintxos and 4 drinks; shared or private option.

title: San Sebastian: Walking Tour of Over 15 Must-See Attractions
summary: Two-hour walk past more than 15 city sights with an English-speaking guide; small-group or private options.

title: San Sebastian: Guided E-Bike Tour
summary: Small-group ride with an English-speaking local guide; e-bike, helmet and rain poncho included. Not for under-15s.

title: San Sebastián: Traditional Cider House Tour with Lunch
summary: Transport to a cider house for a guided tour, cider and pintxo tasting, and lunch of cod omelette, grilled T-bone steak and cheese.

title: Zarautz, Getaria and Zumaia from San Sebastian
summary: Half-day trip along the Gipuzkoa coast in an air-conditioned vehicle with a local guide and guided visits; lunch not included.
